reviews.title: Don’t listen to the app
reviews.text: Early in the morning, I was in the back of the car and I was looking at the moon. I wanted to know what phase it was in, so I pointed my camera at the moon, it wasn’t there, so I looked up moon, and it told me the moon was behind me, when clearly it wasn’t. This app honestly lies, it told me the sun was in front of me when it is behind me. So, sorry, to whomever, but this app isn’t really trustworthy. 😔
